bounded_calibration.png_policy: Retain immutable original full viewport PNG for every full-owner joint mode, every actual-ink extremum/tie witness and every failure. Every ink/DOM observation must map to its own captured original pixels; no synthetic target-only screenshots.
bounded_calibration.stop_on: Any numeric serialization, target font, exact row/owner geometry, full-owner inventory, source or diagnostic mismatch; preserve raw failure and do not expand run automatically.

source_causality.slider_callbacks: draft[k]=v only; runner input handler additionally writes its own output
source_causality.recipe_flight: dt=.1 actual mount callbacks until normal phase capture or missed-window status; no assigned phase/state
source_causality.stepper_string_caveat: Number addition/subtraction passes through browser range sanitization. Candidate String(i/50) is not a proof of that browser result.

conditional_factorization.candidate_count_explanation: 211 unique one-axis tuples plus 21 other baseline phase/hint/pause/audio profiles = 232/context, only after exact native separability evidence. This is not yet a complete legal-layout domain.
required_native_invariants: Every direct range value and every +/- transition produces the declared canonical input and output string.

After every text/value/mode change, force layout, await document.fonts.ready, assert loaded, then obtain Range/ink/CDP/PNG. Re-check font status and stable layout before and after capture; lazy font loading cannot be swallowed.
Each observed owner has full CDP platform font attribution; original font file and runtime bindings remain unchanged.

For all 213 axis values, output/row/group/controls/paper dimensions and other-owner positions relative to the same fixed container are exactly equal to the baseline, except the intended ink. Do not introduce an arbitrary geometry tolerance.
All output ink and fixed siblings remain within their actual safe paper and original viewport after normal scrolling; no clipping or changed row height.
For each of 22 phase/hint/pause/audio modes, capture full original DOM/ink/PNG including toolbar, help/status, progress and hint; record changed y offsets and internal/window scroll.

Measure every candidate actual ink, preserve all ties and width/height/area trade-offs, then reach each selected simultaneous extrema witness through real controls; count characters is never a selector.
If any invariant fails, 232/context cannot claim full coverage. Re-analyze the affected cross-axis/mode dependency rather than silently switching scope or brute-forcing all 6912642 states.

open_obligations.reason: Unbounded path/time/retries are absent from in-game error text; this does not approve result-artifact or replay.

candidate_owner_census.status: source expectation only; compare the entire real DOM/sample census and stop for any unknown/missing owner
